newsitem.title: USA: Schlumberger gets Amoco Grand Banks work.
newsitem.headline: Schlumberger gets Amoco Grand Banks work.

text.p: Sedco Forex said Monday it signed an agreement with Amoco Canada Petroleum Co Ltd for the Amoco Corp unit's 1997 drilling program in the Grand Banks area, offshore Newfoundland.

The program is scheduled to start in May and will include at least one well at the West Bonne Bay prospect, which is about 15 kilometers northeast of the Terra Nova project and 40 kilometers southeast of the Hibernia project, Sedco said. It is a division of Schlumberger Ltd.
It said the semisubmersible drilling unit Bill Shoemaker will be used for the drilling program.

The Bill Shoemaker is owned by RIGCO North America LLC, a DeepTech International Inc subsidiary, and operated under a management agreement by Sedco Forex. The rig is being upgraded for the harsh-environment drilling conditions found offshore Newfoundland and in the North Sea.
